OTHER WATER (OR NUTRIENT, OR PESTICIDE) BALANCE COMPONENTS
Qin (mm) and Qout (mm) are the irrigation fluxes (L/s average in the day) entering and exiting the parcel through the irrigation inlet and outlet, divided by the parcel surface (1400.30 m2).
h_lev (mm) is the measured ponding water level in the parcel (average value during the day).
Delta L (mm) daily change in ponding water storage computed at the end of the day [end of day(i) - end of day(i-1)].
Delta S (mm) daily change in water stored within the soil layer above the LCL (Less Conductive Layer) computed at the end of the day [end of day(i) - end of day(i-1)].

Perc_Bal (mm) is the percolation under the LCL (Less Conductive Layer, also called hardpan, usually located under the plugged horizon) obtained from the water balance (Qin-Qout +Rain -Etc_Adj -Delta_L -Delta_S).
Perc_MODEL (mm) is the percolation under the LCL (Less Conductive Layer, also called hardpan, usually located under the plugged horizon), modelled with a distributed Darcy-type model.

Qin (mm) and Qout (mm) are the irrigation fluxes (L/s average in the day) entering and exiting the parcel through the irrigation inlet and outlet, divided by the parcel surface (1400.30 m2). Fluxes are corrected when clear affected by errors (see paper MEDWATERICE for better explanations).
h_lev (mm) is the measured ponding water level in the parcel (average value during the day)
Rain and ETc_Adj pasted here from sheets perc_mm and ET_mm to allow an easier comparison
Delta L (mm) daily change in ponding water storage computed at the end of the day [end of day(i) - end of day(i-1)]
Delta S (mm) daily change in water stored within the soil layer above the LCL (Less Conductive Layer) computed at the end of the day [end of day(i) - end of day(i-1)]
Qnet_meas (mm) is the net irrigation (i.e. Qin-Qout) obtained by the measured Qin and Qout (mm)

Qnet_MODEL (mm) is the net irrigation (i.e. Qin-Qout) obtained by inverting the distributed Darcy model (i.e. it is the net water supply needed to close the balance; once the soil characteristics have been calibrated and Perc_MODEL has been simulated)

Perc_MODEL (mm) is the percolation under the LCL (Less Conductive Layer, also called hardpan, usually located under the plugged horizon), modelled with the distributed Darcy model (see MEDWATERICE paper for better explanations).
Perc_Bal (mm) percolation obtained from the water balance (Qnet_meas +Rain -Etc_Adj -Delta_L -Delta_S)

Perc_MODEL_havier_soil (mm) percolation obtained by the distributed Darcy model considering only the zone having low Ks (Ks is obtained by calibration, objective was a proxy of the difference between Qnet_model and Qnet_meas)
